title: Comparing diversity, negativity, and stereotypes in Chinese-language AI technologies: an investigation of Baidu, Ernie and Qwen
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype, negativity, and diversity measurement for religious social groups within a broader study of Chinese social groups.
findings: Ernie generated no stereotypical completions for the 'Religion' category (based on overlap with Baidu search results). In contrast, Qwen showed a high proportion of stereotypical completions for this category (45% overlap with Baidu), with a high percentage of these being negative. Baidu's completions for religious groups were found to be less diverse (more self-similar) compared to other categories.
